clues: This town is in the southwest of Cameroon. It sits in the north of the Mungo Valley.
This town lies just south of a mountain. Clouds hang over it most days, so it gets little sun, worst in the wet season.
In late 1966, the Bakossi and Bamileke groups here clashed. The clash came from tension that had grown between the two groups.
Here is the strange part: even under all those clouds, the town keeps running short of water. Its women have worked to make it better.
The landmark that gives it away is Mount Kupe, the mountain that stands just north of this town.
